title: The RegistrationMagic WordPress plugin before 6.1.0.4 does not sanitise and escape a parameter before using it in a…
description: The RegistrationMagic WordPress plugin versions prior to 6.1.0.4 contain a vulnerability where a parameter is not properly sanitized and escaped before being used in a SQL statement. This flaw could allow users with high privileges, such as administrators, to perform SQL injection attacks.
